module_title: Continuous Professional Development (CPD) & NISHTHA: Foundational Concepts
introduction: This foundational level introduces the massive shift in how teacher training is perceived under NEP 2020. It covers the mandatory hours of CPD, the core philosophy of lifelong learning, and the launch of the world's largest teacher training program: NISHTHA.

core_concepts.title: What is Continuous Professional Development (CPD)?
core_concepts.description:
CPD is the ongoing process through which educators improve and broaden their knowledge, skills, and pedagogical practices throughout their careers. 
- Pre-NEP Era: Teacher training was often a one-time, passive, top-down seminar.
- Post-NEP Era: CPD is self-directed, continuous, and highly contextualized to the specific needs of the teacher's classroom.

core_concepts.title: NEP 2020 Mandate: 50 Hours of CPD
core_concepts.description: A highly tested, non-negotiable metric: NEP 2020 mandates that **every teacher and school principal (Head Teacher)** must participate in at least **50 hours** of CPD opportunities every year. These hours cover the latest pedagogies regarding foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN), formative assessment, experiential learning, and inclusive education.

core_concepts.title: NISHTHA: The Flagship Program
core_concepts.description:
NISHTHA stands for the **National Initiative for School Heads' and Teachers' Holistic Advancement**. 
- Launched in 2019 by the Ministry of Education, it is the world’s largest capacity-building program for teachers. 
- Objective: To motivate and equip teachers to encourage and foster critical thinking in students rather than rote learning. It focuses on holistic development, integrating joyful learning, art, and sports into the curriculum.

core_concepts.title: The Shift in Teacher Paradigm
core_concepts.description: CPD aims to change the identity of the teacher from a mere 'Consumer of Knowledge' (delivering a textbook written by someone else) to a 'Creator of Knowledge' and a 'Facilitator' who constructs customized learning experiences for their specific students.

important_entities.name: Principals and School Heads
important_entities.key_fact: CPD is mandatory for leadership, not just teachers.
important_entities.significance: A major focus of NISHTHA is training School Heads. NEP 2020 recognizes that pedagogical transformation cannot happen unless the principal understands and supports these new methods. Therefore, leadership and administrative training are core components of CPD.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will test the philosophy of CPD. A common distractor is: 'CPD is designed to correct the performance of underperforming teachers.' This is **FALSE**. CPD is a universal mandate for **all** educators, recognizing that pedagogy and technology constantly evolve, and even the best teachers must be lifelong learners.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: To remember the full form, always remember it targets BOTH 'Heads and Teachers', and the goal is 'Holistic Advancement'.

exam_strategy_tips: Whenever an exam asks for the exact number of hours mandated for teacher professional development per year under NEP 2020, unconditionally select **50 hours**.
